an3.107:1.1: ruṇṇamidaṃ bhikkhave, ariyassa vinaye yadidaṃ gītaṃ.
an3.107:1.2: ummattakamidaṃ bhikkhave, ariyassa vinaye yadidaṃ naccaṃ.
an3.107:1.3: komārakamidaṃ bhikkhave, ariyassa vinaye yadidaṃ ativelaṃ dantavidaṃsakaṃ hasitaṃ.
an3.107:1.4: tasmātiha bhikkhave, setughāto gīte. setughāto nacce. alaṃ vo dhammappamoditānaṃ sataṃ sitaṃ sitamattāyāti.
